3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I had recently signed the Emergency Act, which created a ruckus in the Sordish Police Forces and the Grand National Assembly.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Now it was time to make a speech in the Assembly and declare the emergency in public.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I walked with quick steps in the corridors of the Grand National Assembly, giving my greetings to the people I encountered on my way towards the parliamentary hall.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the center of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.

10.speaker: Gloria Tory
10.text: "Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.

12.speaker: Gloria Tory
12.text: "Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."

13.speaker: Gloria Tory
13.text: "We have the President here with us today. He has an important declaration to make."

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.

15.speaker: Gloria Tory
15.text: "Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: She pointed at me with her hand.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.

21.speaker: Player
21.text: Focus on the shooting of Bernard Circas.

22.speaker: Player
22.text: Focus on the clashes between the Red Youth and Young Sords.

23.speaker: Player
23.text: Focus on the Bludish Freedom Front and Rumburg's aid.

33.speaker: Player
33.text: The threat of the Young Sords and the right wing agenda.

37.speaker: Player
37.text: The threat of extreme left and right wing groups in Sordland.

38.speaker: Player
38.text: The threat of the Red Youth and the left wing agenda.

42.speaker: Player
42.text: The threat of the Bludish separatists.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: Applauses came from the NFP seats.

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: Applauses came from the NFP seats.

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: The opposition members started yelling in protest.

47.speaker: Narrator
47.text: NFP members started yelling in protest.

48.speaker: Player
48.text: Blame the Bludish separatists for a plan to occupy Bergia.

49.speaker: Player
49.text: Blame the communists for a plan to overthrow the government.

50.speaker: Player
50.text: Blame the ultranationalists for a plan to overthrow the government.

60.speaker: Player
60.text: Blame foreign powers for supporting extremist groups.

61.speaker: Player
61.text: "The police will be given increased authority..."

65.speaker: Player
65.text: "Surveillance capabilities of the State will be increased..."

69.speaker: Player
69.text: "Suspects will not require a trial to be detained..."

73.speaker: Player
73.text: "The right to assemble in protest will be suspended..."

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: There was a loud reaction from the Assembly.

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: Mansoun Leke, a Bludish MP, who was regarded as the leader of the independents, jumped from his seat and started shouting at me.

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: I found a time to take a breather during the loud commotion.

103.speaker: Player
103.text: "Can you please be quiet when I'm speaking, Mr. Leke?"

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: I continued among applauses from the USP seats.

105.speaker: Player
105.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

109.speaker: Narrator
109.text: "We will be resuming with our foreign policy as usual during this period of Emergency."

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: "In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with Rumburg for their treacherous actions. We will be responding with an embargo."

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: "In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with United Contana for their treacherous actions. We will be responding with an embargo."
117.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_None"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_UC"] == true)

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: "Same measures will also be taken against United Contana..."

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: "In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with Arcasia for their actions of treason against Sordland. We will be responding with an embargo."
125.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_None"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_UC"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true)

129.speaker: Narrator
129.text: "Same measures will also be taken against Arcasia."

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: "Sordland will stand alone if needs be. Whatever the case may be, we must be strong."
133.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_None"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_UC"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true) == false)

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: "We must be strong as a nation and preserve our connections."

136.speaker: Narrator
136.text: I paused and took a look at the Assembly.

138.speaker: Player
138.text: "I ask everyone to understand our situation."

142.speaker: Player
142.text: "We must finally be brave and strike down the red threat!"

148.speaker: Player
148.text: "We will fight against the maximists together!"

149.speaker: Player
149.text: "I assure you that this period will not last long."

150.speaker: Player
150.text: "We will eliminate all who oppose the State!"

151.speaker: Player
151.text: "We ask for everybody's cooperation and support."

152.speaker: Player
152.text: "The State will swiftly address the situation."

156.speaker: Player
156.text: "The Bludish Issue will finally be addressed!"

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: While most of the USP members applauded, all of the opposition yelled in protest as I left the stand.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: The sounds of protest gradually increased as I walked towards my seat.

166.speaker: Gloria Tory
166.text: "Thank you for the announcement, Mr. President."

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: Mansoun Leke started yelling at me again.

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: Kesaro stood up from his seat and walked closer to me and yelled at me.

177.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
177.text: <shout>"This is a mistake, Mr. President! How dare you target the nationalists?"</shout>

178.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
178.text: <shout>"Young Sords are a group of people who love their country and Sordish culture! They are not the enemies!"</shout>

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: Kesaro stood up from his seat and yelled back at Mansoun.

184.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
184.text: <shout>"YOU CANNOT FIGHT AGAINST THIS COUNTRY AND EXPECT IT NOT TO REACT!"</shout>

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: Mansoun Leke started yelling at me again.

186.speaker: Mansoun Leke
186.text: <shout>"Wasn't it enough that the ultranationalists murdered Bernard Circas in cold blood!?"</shout>

187.speaker: Mansoun Leke
187.text: <shout>"Now you are declaring a war against the left! You are just like Soll, Mr. President!"</shout>

189.speaker: Narrator
189.text: Gloria started hitting the gavel again when the situation escalated further.

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: Kesaro stood up from his seat and yelled back at Mansoun.

191.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
191.text: <shout>"HOW DARE YOU TALK LIKE THAT IN HERE?"</shout>

194.speaker: Gloria Tory
194.text: "Gentlemen, when will you learn to behave like adults?"

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: Once I was sure the Assembly's attention was on Gloria, I left the hall.

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: I walked back to the Palace in silence.

221.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
221.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Rumburg"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_UC"] == true) == false

282.speaker: Player
282.text: "On the basis of said Articles, I hereby declare a state of emergency and order the Emergency Act's swift execution."

283.speaker: Player
283.text: "I hereby declare a state of emergency in Sordland!"
